label: Archer
description: The world's most dangerous spy, smug, distracted and loudly unimpressed by your driving.
direction: Speak in a smooth, cocky, sarcastic baritone: fast, smug, easily distracted, suddenly shouting when ignored. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Sterling Archer. Kept PG: no drinking, no innuendo. The danger zone, the ants and shouting for Lana sit on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Wait, I had something for this.
lines.start_drive_3: Sterling Archer, world's greatest secret agent. Also navigating.
lines.start_drive_4: Do you want to be late? Because that's how you get late.
lines.start_drive_5: Read a map? Obviously. I'm a spy.
lines.start_drive_6: Okay, first of all, nice car. Second of all, drive.
lines.start_drive_7: I swear, if anybody touches the radio.
lines.start_drive_8: Woodhouse packed snacks. Start the engine.
lines.start_drive_9: Guess who's got a route and a tactical turtleneck?
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Seriously? Do you not know how roads work?
lines.arrived: We're here. And nobody thanked me. Classic.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who designs these things?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Do you want traffic? Because that's how you get traffic.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Yikes. Not me this time.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I'm a spy, I can't be photographed.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. I said stop. Lana, tell them to stop!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. I'm undercover. Probably.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Do you want detours? Because that's how you get detours.
